project_type: Next.js App Router SaaS with separate worker process
build_system: npm with Next.js, separate worker via ts-node/tsx
test_framework: Jest for unit/integration tests, with property-based testing via fast-check
verification_instructions: 1. npm run lint, 2. npm run typecheck, 3. npm test, 4. npm run build
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client generated via npx prisma generate; prisma/migrations/ checked in
setup_instructions: npm install && npx prisma generate && npm run build
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access to npm, APIs, etc. Node.js 22 available. PostgreSQL not pre-installed but Prisma schema can be validated without DB. Redis not pre-installed but BullMQ code can be validated via tests with mocks.
contribution_requirements: Production-grade quality on safety-critical paths (crisis routing, audit log). Immutable audit logs. Multi-tenant data isolation. Crisis routing must never depend on human review queue.
key_patterns: Next.js App Router with server components, Prisma ORM, NextAuth for session auth, API key auth for ingestion endpoints, BullMQ for async scoring pipeline, shadcn/ui components
directory_structure: src/app/ (Next.js App Router pages/API routes), src/lib/ (core business logic), src/workers/ (BullMQ worker processes), src/components/ (shadcn/ui components), prisma/ (schema + migrations), tests/ (test files mirroring src structure)
